Bringing the world's fashion houses home to Addis Ababa.
Our Story

Nonis Women's Clothing is a premium women's fashion store based in Addis Ababa, Ethiopia. We bring carefully selected, original fashion products from international brands around the world to the women who wear them here.

Every piece in our showroom is chosen with an eye for quality, originality, and modern feminine style — because fashion should feel considered, never compromised.

Our Mission

Because every woman deserves to shine.

To provide Ethiopian women with elegant, modern, and premium fashion choices that combine quality, authenticity, luxury experience, and accessibility.

What We Stand For

Premium Quality

Memorable Moments

Who We Dress

The woman who refuses to compromise.

The young professional building her first wardrobe of substance. The entrepreneur dressing for the room she's about to walk into. The woman stepping into a spotlight moment. And the fashion-conscious customer who simply knows the difference — Nonis Women's Clothing is curated for her.
